# 7T-Music — The Board : C++20 / WGSL native instrument (WebGPU via Dawn)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(the_board VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

# ═══ THE NATIVE BUILD CONSTITUTION ═══════════════════════════════════════════
#
# One target, the_board.exe, against Dawn linked as prebuilt static
# libraries at THE PIN below. History, as citations: SUNSET_2 closed the
# native road with a FATAL_ERROR here; SUNRISE_0 N4 reopened it; the
# Emscripten branch and the web presets went with the web twin at tag
# web-sunset (docs/LAWS.md: WEB_SUNSET).
# `the-board-full-release` is the program, on either lane: Ninja for the
# command line and for the vcpkg-injection examiner N10 names, Visual
# Studio for the multi-config lane, where Debug — the diagnostic build,
# CONFIG AXIS below — is one --config away. The preset surface is
# orthogonal by ruling (HELM_0): the demo column is chosen by preset,
# the configuration by lane.
#
# THE DAWN PIN: 56f332d7d8d03f36149f201ab8cce8aee187e8c6 (v20260814.182433)
# — one generation, three artifacts, one checkout (L37): C:/dev/dawn as
# linked here; third_party/dawn_native_headers (the gates' native
# surface); third_party/emdawnwebgpu (the gates' cartridge surface).
# Build recipe: docs/reference/DAWN_REFERENCE.md.

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# ── CONFIG AXIS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Debug and Release, and nothing else — for two native reasons.
# 1. Dawn's prebuilt static libraries exist in exactly those two
#    configurations, and dawn_lib() proves every row for every config in
#    DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS at configure time. A third name would link neither.
# 2. Debug is the diagnostic build: the program unoptimized against
#    Dawn's OWN Debug libraries, whose assertions and backend validation
#    are the deepest instrument this tree can arm without writing one.
#    (PORT_2c's web-era arming — SAFE_HEAP and kin — went with the twin
#    at web-sunset; whether the native side should arm more than Dawn's
#    asserts is docs/OPEN.md, THE DEBUG ARMING.)
#    Reached on the VS lane (`--build --preset the-board-vs-debug`).
#    Every Ninja preset pins Release, so a Ninja Debug is a bare
#    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug configure.
# Multi-config generators choose per build via --config; single-config
# generators choose per tree via CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.
get_property(IS_MULTI_CONFIG GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
if(IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
    set(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES "Debug;Release" CACHE STRING
        "The diagnostic axis (PORT_2c); also the configs Dawn provides" FORCE)
    set(DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS Debug Release)
else()
    if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug" CACHE STRING
            "Build type: Debug (diagnostic) or Release (-O2)" FORCE)
    endif()
    if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "^(Debug|Release)$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE '${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}' — the axis is Debug or Release: Dawn's prebuilt libraries exist in exactly those two configurations, and a third name would link neither (see CONFIG AXIS).")
    endif()
    set(DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})
endif()


set(DAWN_DIR "C:/dev/dawn" CACHE PATH "Dawn source directory")
set(DAWN_BUILD "C:/dev/dawn/out" CACHE PATH "Dawn build directory")

message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "7T-Music — The Board (native, WebGPU/Dawn)")
message(STATUS "  Dawn: ${DAWN_DIR}")
message(STATUS "  Build: ${DAWN_BUILD}")
message(STATUS "")

# Dawn include directories
# N10 — the glfw include row is single-sourced so the sentry below can
# probe the marquee header under the same address the compiler is given.
set(DAWN_GLFW_INCLUDE "${DAWN_DIR}/third_party/glfw3/src/include")

set(DAWN_INCLUDES
    ${DAWN_DIR}/include
    ${DAWN_DIR}/src
    ${DAWN_BUILD}/gen/include
    ${DAWN_BUILD}/gen/src
    ${DAWN_GLFW_INCLUDE}
)

# ─── N10 — THE INCLUDE SENTRY ───────────────────────────────────────────
# The lib guard below names a missing LIBRARY by full concrete path before
# any compilation. Nothing did the same for INCLUDE directories, and the
# failure mode of a dangling include dir is WORSE than a missing lib: it
# does not fail at all when any ambient provider can satisfy the name.
# That is not hypothetical — it is how this tree built for the whole
# campaign. The tag-era row `third_party/glfw/include` does not exist at
# Dawn pin 56f332d7 (FetchContent roots glfw at third_party/glfw3/src),
# and the compile succeeded anyway because vcpkg's USER-WIDE MSBUILD
# INTEGRATION injected its own include path. /showIncludes confessed:
#
#   Note: including file:  C:\vcpkg\installed\x64-windows\include\GLFW/glfw3.h
#
# vcpkg headers against Dawn's pinned glfw3.lib — benign in practice (the
# world ran, dropped_submits=0) but an UNDECLARED MACHINE DEPENDENCY and a
# header/lib generation skew, which is the one-generation law's exact
# hazard (L37) wearing a build-system costume.
#
# The sentry walks every include dir and probes the marquee header, so a
# dangling row is named at configure and the vacuum an ambient provider
# would fill never opens. WHAT IT CANNOT SEE, stated plainly: injection
# ON TOP of valid dirs happens on MSBuild's side of the fence, invisible
# to CMake. That class has exactly one examiner — the Ninja lane, whose
# honesty is that it is not MSBuild and gets no vcpkg integration at all.
foreach(T7_INC_DIR ${DAWN_INCLUDES})
    if(NOT EXISTS "${T7_INC_DIR}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Missing Dawn include directory: ${T7_INC_DIR} — a dangling "
            "include dir does not fail the compile while an ambient provider "
            "(vcpkg MSBuild integration, a system include) can satisfy the "
            "names; it silently substitutes an unpinned generation. Fix the "
            "row, never the environment.")
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT EXISTS "${DAWN_GLFW_INCLUDE}/GLFW/glfw3.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "GLFW marquee header absent: ${DAWN_GLFW_INCLUDE}/GLFW/glfw3.h — "
        "the directory exists but does not hold glfw3.h, so the compiler "
        "would take GLFW from whatever the environment offers.")
endif()

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LIBRARY DISCOVERY FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Verifies the library exists for every config in DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS at
# configure time; the $<CONFIG> in PATH resolves per build.
function(dawn_lib VAR PATH)
    foreach(CFG ${DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS})
        string(REPLACE "$<CONFIG>" "${CFG}" CONCRETE "${DAWN_BUILD}/${PATH}")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${CONCRETE}")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing Dawn library: ${CONCRETE}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(${VAR} "${DAWN_BUILD}/${PATH}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# An optional present in some configs but not all is an error: the optional
# set must be identical across configs, or the link truth differs per config.
function(dawn_lib_optional VAR PATH)
    set(FOUND_ALL TRUE)
    set(FOUND_ANY FALSE)
    foreach(CFG ${DAWN_CHECK_CONFIGS})
        string(REPLACE "$<CONFIG>" "${CFG}" CONCRETE "${DAWN_BUILD}/${PATH}")
        if(EXISTS "${CONCRETE}")
            set(FOUND_ANY TRUE)
        else()
            set(FOUND_ALL FALSE)
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(FOUND_ALL)
        set(${VAR} "${DAWN_BUILD}/${PATH}" PARENT_SCOPE)
        message(STATUS "  Found optional: ${PATH}")
    elseif(FOUND_ANY)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Optional Dawn library exists in some configs but not all: ${PATH}")
    else()
        set(${VAR} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
endfunction()

message(STATUS "Discovering Dawn libraries...")

# So we go: Application -> High-level -> Mid-level -> Low-level -> System
#
# Defined before any target so all executables can reference DAWN_LIBS.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Shared MSVC options (applied per-target below)
# ── SUNRISE_0 N7 — /Zc:preprocessor IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT HYGIENE ─────
# src/console/organ_registry.hpp forwards five variadic macros:
#     #define ORGAN_PARAM(...)  ORGAN_PARAM_NS(the_board, __VA_ARGS__)
# and 366 rows of organ_params.inc ride them. MSVC's TRADITIONAL
# preprocessor does not re-split __VA_ARGS__ on commas when it is
# forwarded into another macro — the whole pack arrives as ONE argument,
# so every enrolled dial reaches ORGAN_PARAM_NS with the wrong arity.
# /Zc:preprocessor selects the conforming preprocessor and the 366 rows
# expand as written. Jean's falsifier proved the one-flag cure.
#
# WHY IT WAS NEVER SEEN BEFORE NATIVE. emcc's clang is conforming by
# default, so the ORGAN forwarders always worked on the web twin and the
# defect was MSVC's traditional preprocessor's alone. It belongs in the
# MSVC set and nowhere else.
#
# IT WAS AN ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE UNTIL NOW. The first native build carried
# it through the shell, which means the build was reproducible only for
# someone who knew to export it — L39's own failure shape, one layer up.
# The tree states its own requirement from here.
set(MSVC_COMPILE_OPTS /W3 /wd4251 /wd4275 /wd4244 /wd4267 /EHsc /Zc:preprocessor
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/Z7>")
# Release links produce a full PDB with codegen unchanged: /OPT:REF and
# /OPT:ICF are the plain-Release defaults that /DEBUG would otherwise
# disable. The PDB never ships; it is archived beside the tagged exe.
set(MSVC_LINK_OPTS
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/DEBUG:FULL>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/OPT:REF>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/OPT:ICF>"
    "$<$<CONFIG:Release>:/INCREMENTAL:NO>")
# __WINDOWS_MM__ selects RtMidi's Windows Multimedia backend. RtMidi
# compiles to an empty TU without a backend define, and the link then
# fails on RtMidiIn's constructor rather than on anything that names it.
# winmm.lib is already carried at LEVEL 9 of the link list above.
set(MSVC_COMPILE_DEFS NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
    __WINDOWS_MM__)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ACTIVE CARTRIDGE SELECTION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# Controls which render cartridge the the_board target includes.
# IntelliSense will only index it — no noise from other cartridges.
#
# Change here to switch focus. No need to edit .cpp files.
#
#   Render cartridges:   src/cartridges/<name>/cartridge.hpp
#
#   Available render cartridges: the_board
#
# The analysis side is canvas_1 (src/analysis/canvas_1/canvas.hpp): it
# opens the DAW's loopMIDI port and publishes the stat layout the render
# side binds by name. There is no analysis cartridge selection dial.
#
# AN UNSET VALUE HERE IS A COMPILE ERROR, NEVER A FALLBACK. These values are
# pasted into enumerators (INCUBATE_DEMO into demos/matrix.hpp, T7_INSTRUMENTS
# into core/instruments.hpp). CMake drops an empty ENTRY but keeps an entry
# whose VALUE is empty, so a dial left unset arrives DEFINED AND EMPTY:
# #ifndef never fires and the paste names an enumerator that does not exist.
# The definitions themselves are attached below, beside the build stamp.
#
# THE COLUMN IS CHOSEN BY PRESET (HELM_0). `full` is the program's and
# the default; `the-board-minimal` selects `minimal`. Any further column
# is reached on the configure line — `-DTHE_BOARD_DEMO=<column>` — until
# it earns a preset of its own. Configuration is NOT chosen here: that
# is the lane's job (CONFIG AXIS above).

set(T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE     "the_board"        CACHE STRING "Render cartridge for the 'the_board' target")
set(THE_BOARD_DEMO                    "full"             CACHE STRING "the_board demo sentence (a DemoCol column of demos/matrix.hpp; compile-time door, DEMO-1). Default IS the golden path.")
set(T7_INSTRUMENTS                    "off"              CACHE STRING "Recurring self-measurement (an InstrumentCol column of core/instruments.hpp): off | meter | full. Default off — the shipped frame pays for no reading nobody reads. 'meter' arms the frame meter + its [METER] table for a measurement session.")

# THE PIN (DRAW_0). The one dial here whose EMPTY IS LEGAL — and empty
# is the default. Empty means the world's master seed is DRAWN at boot
# from the wall clock (cartridge.hpp, boot_seed), so an ordinary build draws
# with no CMake change at all. A number PINS the world to that seed,
# exactly reproducible: -DT7_WORLD_SEED=42 restores the authored world
# (DEMO_SEED, demos/matrix.hpp).
#
# The paste law above does NOT apply to this one, and the guard below is
# why: an unset value here is never pasted at all. The define is dropped
# entirely, so the source reads #ifdef — not an empty paste that would
# name nothing.
set(T7_WORLD_SEED                     ""                 CACHE STRING "The world's master seed. EMPTY (the default) = DRAWN at boot from the wall clock — each visit is a new world. A number PINS the world to that seed and reproduces it exactly (42 is the authored world, DEMO_SEED in demos/matrix.hpp).")

set(T7_WORLD_SEED_DEFS)
if(NOT T7_WORLD_SEED STREQUAL "")
    set(T7_WORLD_SEED_DEFS T7_WORLD_SEED=${T7_WORLD_SEED})
endif()

message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "Active cartridges:")
message(STATUS "  the_board -> render: ${T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE} demo: ${THE_BOARD_DEMO}")
message(STATUS "  Instruments:    ${T7_INSTRUMENTS}")
if(T7_WORLD_SEED STREQUAL "")
    message(STATUS "  World seed:     drawn at boot (wall clock)")
else()
    message(STATUS "  World seed:     pinned to ${T7_WORLD_SEED}")
endif()
message(STATUS "")

message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "Configuration complete:")
message(STATUS "  Generator: ${CMAKE_GENERATOR}")
if(IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
    message(STATUS "  Build type: multi-config (${CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES}) — chosen per build via --config")
else()
    message(STATUS "  Build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
endif()
message(STATUS "  C++ Standard: ${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}")
message(STATUS "")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# THE BOARD — Render cartridge development
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
# The render cartridge (the_board) driven by canvas_1's analysis signal.
# Uses T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE.
#
# Build:  cmake --build --preset the-board-full-release  (full chain: CLAUDE.md)
#

# Only the active cartridge's headers → scoped IntelliSense
file(GLOB_RECURSE T7_RENDER_HEADERS
    "src/cartridges/${T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE}/*.hpp"
)

add_executable(the_board
    src/the_board.cpp
    # The one other translation unit: RtMidi's Windows MM backend, the
    # canvas's route to the DAW's virtual port. Vendored, not header-only,
    # so it compiles separately; __WINDOWS_MM__ below selects its backend.
    src/external/RtMidi.cpp
    ${T7_RENDER_HEADERS}
)

target_include_directories(the_board PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

# The program resolves world.wgsl and assets/ by paths relative to the
# working directory, and its two candidates are written for an exe sitting
# directly in the build directory - the Ninja layout. The VS generator adds
# a per-config folder (Debug/, Release/), so the debugger starts one level
# deeper and both candidates miss. Pin the debugger to the repo root, where
# the src-relative candidate resolves on either generator. Ignored by Ninja.
set_target_properties(the_board PROPERTIES
    VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")

# The native includes and link list, both from the Dawn section above
# (SUNRISE_0 N4).
target_include_directories(the_board PRIVATE ${DAWN_INCLUDES})
target_link_libraries(the_board PRIVATE ${DAWN_LIBS})

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(the_board PRIVATE ${MSVC_COMPILE_OPTS})
    target_link_options(the_board PRIVATE ${MSVC_LINK_OPTS})
    target_compile_definitions(the_board PRIVATE ${MSVC_COMPILE_DEFS})
endif()

# ── PURSE_0 R2 — THE BUILD STAMP ─────────────────────────────────────
#
# The program states its own provenance at boot. The wasm sha names the
# ARTIFACT, and went with the web twin; this names the TREE.
#
# IT LIVES IN THE BUILD DIRECTORY, and that is the whole design decision.
# Every other generated file here is tracked and hand-run; a stamp cannot
# be, because it carries a timestamp — a tracked copy would dirty the tree
# on every build and hold the binding gate's S-6 witness ("porcelain
# clean; HEAD == pushed tip") red forever, and `git describe --dirty`
# would report dirt caused by its own output. tools/build_stamp.py's
# banner carries the full reasoning.
#
# TWO STEPS, AND EACH ANSWERS A DIFFERENT QUESTION. The configure-time run
# guarantees the file EXISTS before the first compile; the custom target is
# always out of date by construction, which is the only way to observe HEAD
# moving WITHOUT a reconfigure (R-E). The script writes only when the
# string differs, so an always-run step costs no relink.
#
# A PROVENANCE INSTRUMENT MUST NOT BE ABLE TO BREAK THE BUILD. With no
# Python interpreter the configure writes an honest "unknown" stamp once
# and no target is added: the program compiles and says it does not know,
# which is the one thing a stamp may say other than the truth.
set(T7_STAMP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen")
set(T7_STAMP_FILE "${T7_STAMP_DIR}/build_stamp.gen.inc")
set(T7_STAMP_TOOL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/build_stamp.py")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${T7_STAMP_DIR}")

# TWO WAYS TO FIND THE INTERPRETER, because one of them is enough to lose
# the instrument silently. find_package is the correct road; find_program
# on both spellings is the net under it (Windows ships `python`, not
# `python3`, and this tree's own build chain is driven from a .bat).
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
    set(T7_PYTHON "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}")
else()
    find_program(T7_PYTHON NAMES python3 python)
endif()

if(T7_PYTHON)
    execute_process(COMMAND "${T7_PYTHON}" "${T7_STAMP_TOOL}" "${T7_STAMP_FILE}"
                    RESULT_VARIABLE T7_STAMP_RC)
else()
    set(T7_STAMP_RC 1)
endif()

if(T7_STAMP_RC EQUAL 0)
    add_custom_target(t7_build_stamp
        BYPRODUCTS "${T7_STAMP_FILE}"
        COMMAND "${T7_PYTHON}" "${T7_STAMP_TOOL}" "${T7_STAMP_FILE}"
        COMMENT "build stamp (git describe + UTC; rewritten only on change)"
        VERBATIM)
    add_dependencies(the_board t7_build_stamp)
    message(STATUS "  Build stamp:    ${T7_STAMP_FILE}")
else()
    file(WRITE "${T7_STAMP_FILE}"
         "// GENERATED at configure time — the stamp tool did not run.\n"
         "inline constexpr const char* BUILD_STAMP = \"unknown\";\n")
    message(STATUS "  Build stamp:    unknown (the stamp tool did not run; it says so)")
endif()

target_include_directories(the_board PRIVATE "${T7_STAMP_DIR}")

# THE PROGRAM'S DIALS, RE-HOMED AT WEB_SUNSET. They were the program's on
# both twins and yet lived only in the web branch, so on native they reached
# nothing at all — `the-board-full-release-meter` set T7_INSTRUMENTS=meter and
# the compiler never heard it. Pre-existing defect, found by the W-recon,
# repaired here on the way out rather than deleted along with its only home.
target_compile_definitions(the_board PRIVATE
    INCUBATE_RENDER=${T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE}
    INCUBATE_DEMO=${THE_BOARD_DEMO}
    T7_INSTRUMENTS=${T7_INSTRUMENTS}
    ${T7_WORLD_SEED_DEFS}   # empty ⇒ nothing pasted ⇒ the seed is drawn
)

add_custom_command(TARGET the_board POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets
    $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:the_board>/assets
    COMMENT "Copying assets for the_board..."
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PIVOT_0 E3 — DXC RUNTIME LOGISTICS (Windows native only)
#
# Tint->DXC needs dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll BESIDE THE EXE at runtime.
# Without dxil.dll the compiler produces unsigned DXIL and the driver
# refuses it; without dxcompiler.dll the `use_dxc` toggle has nothing to
# call. Both must land in the exe directory after a clean build.
#
# P1 — ASSERT-AND-GUARD. Dawn lives OUT OF TREE (DAWN_DIR, default
# C:/dev/dawn) and this repo cannot open it, so search, and if nothing is
# found, SAY SO and keep configuring. A missing pair must not fail the
# build — it must produce a boot that fails loudly with a log line
# pointing back here.
#
# ─── EMBER_0 — THE HYPOTHESIS WAS CHECKED, AND IT WAS FALSE ──────────
# P1 called Dawn's DXC carriage "a HYPOTHESIS, not a checked fact".
# EMBER_0's RECON.4 checked it at pin 56f332d7 and the answer is no:
# EnsureDXCLibraries — the ONLY site in the D3D12 backend that opens
# dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll — is wrapped whole in
# `#if defined(DAWN_USE_BUILT_DXC)` with NO `#else`
# (PlatformFunctionsD3D12.cpp: the #if, the function, the #endif, then
# the namespace close). C:/dev/dawn/out is built with
# DAWN_USE_BUILT_DXC:BOOL=OFF, and dawn_native only gets the define
# inside `if (DAWN_USE_BUILT_DXC)`, so the loader is ABSENT from the
# library this program links. The gate is comprehensive — BackendD3D12
# and PhysicalDeviceD3D12 sit behind the same define.
#
# CONSEQUENCE, PLAINLY: any pair copied here is INERT until Dawn is
# rebuilt with that option ON. No placement of DLLs reaches code that
# was never compiled. The copy is not useless — it is the correct
# machinery, one build option early.
#
# THE WINDOWS SDK GLOB IS GONE (EMBER_0, and it dies now rather than
# after the rebuild, while removing it can break nothing). It resolved
# first on every machine that had an SDK, which meant this build shipped
# whatever DXC generation the host happened to carry, beside a Dawn
# pinned at 56f332d7 — an UNDECLARED MACHINE DEPENDENCY and a generation
# skew, which is N10's vcpkg phantom wearing a second costume. Proof it
# was firing rather than idle: the boot log read
# `DXC runtime: C:/Program Files (x86)/Windows Kits/10/bin/10.0.26100.0/x64`.
# The candidates are now Dawn's own build directories alone, which is
# what the comment below always said it wanted: the pair that sits
# beside the libs and MATCHES the Dawn being linked. T7_DXC_DIR still
# overrides, deliberately — an explicit path a human typed is a
# declared dependency, which is the whole difference.
#
# Set T7_DXC_DIR at configure time to override the search entirely.
if(WIN32)
    set(T7_DXC_DIR "" CACHE PATH
        "Directory holding dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll (empty = search)")

    set(T7_DXC_CANDIDATES "")
    if(T7_DXC_DIR)
        list(APPEND T7_DXC_CANDIDATES "${T7_DXC_DIR}")
    endif()
    # Dawn's own output first: if that build set DAWN_USE_BUILT_DXC, the
    # pair sits beside the libs already and matches the Dawn being linked.
    list(APPEND T7_DXC_CANDIDATES
        "${DAWN_BUILD}/Debug"
        "${DAWN_BUILD}/Release"
        "${DAWN_BUILD}"
    )
    # (The Windows SDK glob stood here and was excised at EMBER_0 — see
    # the banner above. An unpinned ambient provider is not a fallback,
    # it is a silent substitution.)

    set(T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR "")
    foreach(CAND IN LISTS T7_DXC_CANDIDATES)
        if(EXISTS "${CAND}/dxcompiler.dll" AND EXISTS "${CAND}/dxil.dll")
            set(T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR "${CAND}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()

    if(T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR)
        message(STATUS "  DXC runtime: ${T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR} (dxcompiler.dll + dxil.dll)")
        add_custom_command(TARGET the_board POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                "${T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR}/dxcompiler.dll"
                "${T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR}/dxil.dll"
                $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:the_board>
            COMMENT "PIVOT_0: copying DXC runtime (dxcompiler.dll, dxil.dll)..."
        )
    else()
        # The honest else-branch P1 requires. Not FATAL_ERROR: a tree that
        # will not configure teaches nothing, and the Vulkan plan needs
        # neither dll.
        message(STATUS
            "  DXC runtime: NOT FOUND in ${T7_DXC_CANDIDATES} — expected "
            "until Dawn is rebuilt with DAWN_USE_BUILT_DXC=ON "
            "(tools/ember_route_a.py). The resident Vulkan plan needs "
            "neither dll; only CompilerPlan::D3D12_Dxc does, and that "
            "lane is halted until the rebuild lands (docs/OPEN.md: "
            "EMBER_0).")
    endif()
endif()

# ─── EMBER_0 — THE POST-BUILD MANIFEST ──────────────────────────────
# A post-build step that does not run is invisible: its COMMENT prints
# when the step is REACHED, not when it succeeds. That is not a
# hypothesis either — after a certified MSBuild build whose log showed
# both copy comments, `dir /s /b out\build\the-board-full-release\*.dll`
# returned File Not Found with the tree present. docs/OPEN.md's own
# reopening clause for the pwsh finding names exactly that condition,
# and it has fired.
#
# So the last post-build step reports what is ACTUALLY beside the exe.
# A silent non-landing becomes a visible ABSENT line. It reports and
# never fails — a witness that can break the build is a witness nobody
# leaves armed.
add_custom_command(TARGET the_board POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
        -DT7_EXE_DIR=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:the_board>
        -DT7_EXE_NAME=$<TARGET_FILE_NAME:the_board>
        -DT7_WANT_DXC=$<BOOL:${T7_DXC_FOUND_DIR}>
        -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/post_build_manifest.cmake"
    COMMENT "EMBER_0: post-build manifest — what landed beside the exe"
    VERBATIM
)

source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cartridges/${T7_RENDER_CARTRIDGE}"
    PREFIX "Render Cartridge"
    FILES ${T7_RENDER_HEADERS}
)

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit/ORGAN.md` | `tools/organ_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py` |
| `audit/BINDING_LEDGER.md` | `tools/binding_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py` |
| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

**Every row green, and the room rebuilds.** Delete the five files in `audit/`,
run the five tools above, and the tree is byte-identical again (L33's standing
witness, run at this commit). A red row here is news: read the gate before the
tree, and check `docs/OPEN.md` for anything already ruled.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit/ORGAN.md` | `tools/organ_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py` |
| `audit/BINDING_LEDGER.md` | `tools/binding_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py` |
| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

**Every row green, and the room rebuilds.** Delete the five files in `audit/`,
run the five tools above, and the tree is byte-identical again (L33's standing
witness, run at this commit). A red row here is news: read the gate before the
tree, and check `docs/OPEN.md` for anything already ruled.
# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## Where truth lives

- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit/ORGAN.md` | `tools/organ_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py` |
| `audit/BINDING_LEDGER.md` | `tools/binding_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py` |
| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |

| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit/ORGAN.md` | `tools/organ_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py` |
| `audit/BINDING_LEDGER.md` | `tools/binding_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py` |
| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

**Every row green, and the room rebuilds.** Delete the five files in `audit/`,
run the five tools above, and the tree is byte-identical again (L33's standing
witness, run at this commit). A red row here is news: read the gate before the
tree, and check `docs/OPEN.md` for anything already ruled.

- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

## The ledgers and their tools

| generated file | its tool | the invocation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit/ORGAN.md` | `tools/organ_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py` |
| `audit/BINDING_LEDGER.md` | `tools/binding_ledger.py` | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py` |
| `audit/COMMAND_LEDGER.md` | `tools/command_census.py` | `python3 tools/command_census.py` |
| `audit/MIRROR_LEDGER.md` | `tools/mirror_census.py` | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py` |
| `audit/MANIFEST.md` + `binding_surface.gen.inc`, `binding_registry.hpp`, `limits_floor.gen.inc`, `features_wallet.gen.inc` | `tools/binding_gen.py` (authority: `tools/binding_schema.py`) | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --write` |

## The gates
Run from the repo root. Jean runs glaw1 and the build; the rest run anywhere
python3 and clang++ do.

| gate | the invocation | what it asserts | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G-LAW 1 | `sh tools/gates/glaw1/run.sh` | the real cartridge TU compiles against the pinned SDK surface | GREEN |
| G-LAW 2 | `python3 tools/gates/glaw2/run.py` | no dangling name, no structural break in `world.wgsl` | GREEN |
| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

**Every row green, and the room rebuilds.** Delete the five files in `audit/`,
run the five tools above, and the tree is byte-identical again (L33's standing
witness, run at this commit). A red row here is news: read the gate before the
tree, and check `docs/OPEN.md` for anything already ruled.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
Emscripten/emdawnwebgpu, vendored). Audience: everexpandingboard.com.
The program is essentially artwork; engineering serves that.

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

| TU gate | `python3 tools/gates/console_gate/run.py` | `cartridge.hpp` and `console.hpp` type-check with zero diagnostics | PASS |
| shell gate | `python3 tools/gates/shell_gate/run.py` | the seam between `organ_registry.hpp` and `web/organ_panel.js` agrees | GREEN |
| sha256 gate | `python3 tools/gates/sha256_gate/run.py` | `src/core/sha256.hpp` agrees with hashlib, `world.wgsl` included | PASS |
| score census | `python3 tools/gates/score/run.py` | roster ↔ frame-spine bijection | GREEN |
| WGSL gate | `python3 tools/wgsl_gate.py` | naga parses, scopes and validates the raw module | PASS |
| binding surface | `python3 tools/binding_gen.py --check` | schema ↔ tree ↔ emitters agree; S-6 also wants a clean tree at the pushed tip | PASS |
| organ gap | `python3 tools/organ_gap.py --gate` | no graduated pair kept a surviving runtime reader | PASS |
| organ ledger | `python3 tools/organ_ledger.py --check` | every enrolled dial's field is named by a declared reader | PASS |
| mirror census | `python3 tools/mirror_census.py --check` | the C++↔WGSL mirror and the binding idioms hold, and every pin MIRROR_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |
| binding ledger | `python3 tools/binding_ledger.py --check` | the reach census holds, and every pin BINDING_LEDGER carries matches the live file | GREEN |

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via

## Boot preflight (every session, before any claim about history)
- `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → if true, `git fetch --unshallow origin`.
  Shallow clones silently report graft-boundary dates and fake divergence.
- Work on master unless the handoff says otherwise. Handoff outranks harness defaults.

## The triangle
Jean holds all gates: build (glaw1), visual sign-off, merge, deploy, naming.
Claude holds architecture, rulings, and handoff authoring.
CC executes handoffs on the tree: recon before edit, STOP-on-mismatch scoped to
the unit, flag-and-continue, one commit per logical unit, report findings without
improvising on authority-bearing decisions. Cite symbols, not line numbers.

## Build & deploy (Jean runs these; listed for orientation)
cmake --preset the-board-web → cmake --build --preset the-board-web
→ python tools\web_dist.py → npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=7t
(the persistent EMSDK user variable carries the presets — L40)
dist/ is the deploy target. web/ holds the shell sources and receives the
build artifacts; only dist/ ships.

## Where truth lives
- docs/LAWS.md — the rule book. Read before proposing.
- docs/OPEN.md — the only home of open/parked state.
- docs/HANDOFFS/ — open work orders only; if it's in here, it isn't
  done. (The directory exists only while work is open — absence is health.)
- audit/ — the machine's room: generated ledgers only, never hand-edited
  (L28). MANIFEST.md and BINDING_LEDGER.md are law and stay searchable.
  Each file below is regenerated by its own tool; `--check` prints the
  census without writing.
- The tree holds living matter only; git history is the attic.
  Resurrect: `git checkout <sha>^ -- <path>`.

  census without writing.

# 7T — The Ever Expanding Board · session constitution

7T is a web-first WebGPU generative artwork (C++20 + WGSL, Dawn via
